source:
@@U03345@@
had I not thrust them upward
to enchant your senses
with a grand spectacle?
In the days when my parents,
Night and 卡俄斯, prevailed,
I was strong and made no secret of it.
Playing boyhood games with the Titans,
we tossed around 珀利翁山 and 奥萨山
like so many balls; until finally,
tired of our youthful exuberance,
as a prank,
we wickedly tossed the two mountains
on top of Parnassus,
giving it a twin-peaked cap.
阿波罗, now, likes nothing so much as
dwelling there with the choir of bless¢d Muses.
And who but I fashioned and thrust on high
the throne for 宙斯 and his thunderbolts?
So here I am again, thrusting
with unspeakable strength out of the abyss,
welcoming all who will to begin a new life
and settle on the new land that is me!

@@U03347@@
Had we not seen with our own eyes
this mountain squeezed from the earth,
wed say it was old as time.
It’s rocks are still on the rise,
pushing into place,
and a forest is growing its way up the slope.
But that means nothing to us 斯芬克斯们.
We sit enthroned on our sacred site,
and nothing disturbs us.

@@U03349@@
We see golden foil and nuggets quivering,
gleaming through a million crannies.
Emmets, this is no treasure to lose!
Get busy there and dig out your hoard!
translation:
@@U03345@@
如果我没有把它们向上推
迷惑你的感官
盛况空前？
在我父母的日子里，
夜晚和卡俄斯，占了上风，
我很坚强，毫不掩饰这一点。
与泰坦队一起玩童年游戏，
我们在珀利翁山和奥萨山转来转去
像很多球一样；直到最后，
厌倦了我们青春的活力，
作为一个恶作剧，
我们恶狠狠地把两座山扔了
帕纳塞斯山顶上，
给它戴上双尖帽。
阿波罗现在最喜欢的就是
与神圣缪斯的合唱团居住在那里。
除了我塑造并推向高处之外还有谁
宙斯和他的雷电的王位？
所以我又来了，推力
带着难以言喻的力量走出深渊，
欢迎所有愿意开始新生活的人
并定居在我的新土地上！

@@U03347@@
如果我们没有亲眼所见
这座山从大地中挤出来，
我们说它已经很古老了。
它的岩石仍在上升，
推入到位，
一片森林正在沿着斜坡生长。
但这对我们斯芬克斯人来说毫无意义。
我们坐在我们的圣地上，
没有什么可以打扰我们。

@@U03349@@
我们看到金箔和金块在颤抖，
透过一百万个缝隙闪闪发光。
埃米特斯，这不是一个可以失去的宝藏！
在那里忙起来，挖出你的宝藏！
